name: CROSSCOOP Shinjuku AVENUE
card: Between Shinjuku-sanchome and Shinjuku-gyoemmae, with a 24-hour lounge on the 7th floor
title: CROSSCOOP Shinjuku AVENUE — bright private rooms with big windows on floors 4–7, and a 7th-floor lounge open 24 hours
lead: CROSSCOOP Shinjuku AVENUE sits between Shinjuku-sanchome and Shinjuku-gyoemmae stations, three minutes' walk from either. It uses floors 4 to 7, and the website says it has many bright private rooms with large windows. The 7th-floor lounge is free to use 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and there are eight meeting rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Lounge (7F) / 8 meeting rooms (7 on 6F, 1 on 4F) / Telecube / private rooms (1–24 people)
3 min from Shinjuku-sanchome Sta. / 3 min from Shinjuku-gyoemmae Sta. / 7 min from JR Shinjuku Sta.
concept: Bright private rooms between two stations
CROSSCOOP Shinjuku AVENUE sits between Shinjuku-sanchome and Shinjuku-gyoemmae stations, so you can commute from either.
The website highlights fully private rooms with face-recognition security and the large number of bright rooms with big windows.
steps: The lounge on the 7th floor is free to use 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
Both wired LAN and Wi-Fi are available.
Seven on the 6th floor, one on the 4th
There are eight meeting rooms in all — seven on the 6th floor and one on the 4th — including rooms for 6 and 10.
The Telecube for web meetings can be used without booking.
Private rooms range from 1 to 24 people, in many sizes across the floors.
Many are bright rooms with large windows.

word.title: What is a Telecube?
body: A small box-shaped private booth for web meetings and calls. At CROSSCOOP Shinjuku AVENUE it is free and needs no booking.
It gives you a place outside your room where you can talk without worrying about being overheard.

name: fabbit Ginza
card: Private rooms for 2–6, three minutes from Ginza-itchome Station
title: fabbit Ginza — private offices with a coworking lounge, on the 7th floor of the Hulic Ginza 1-chome Showa-dori Building
lead: fabbit Ginza is on the 7th floor of the Hulic Ginza 1-chome Showa-dori Building, a three-minute walk from Ginza-itchome Station on the Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line. It is listed on the official website of the rental-office brand CROSSCOOP as one of its sites. It has fully private rooms for 2 to 6 people, a coworking lounge, meeting rooms and phone booths. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Private rooms (2–6 people) / coworking lounge / meeting room / phone booths
3 min from Ginza-itchome Sta. / 3 min from Takaracho Sta. / 5 min from Kyobashi Sta.
concept: Balancing work and refreshment
The website describes the shared facilities as “diverse shared spaces that balance working and refreshing”.

Ginza-itchome, Takaracho and Kyobashi stations are all within walking distance, and the site is on the 7th floor of a building on Showa-dori. Private rooms for 2 to 6 people are sized for small teams.
steps: A place to work outside your room
Past reception is the coworking lounge.
It is a shared space where private-room tenants can change scene while working.
There is a meeting room and phone booths.
Client meetings and online calls can both be handled on the same floor.
Private rooms hold 2 to 6 people, all fully enclosed, and company registration is possible.
The website calls it “a high-grade office designed for ease of work”.

word.title: What is a coworking lounge?
body: A shared workspace that rental-office tenants use outside their private rooms. fabbit Ginza has one.
For a team in a small room, it means a second place to work beyond their own door.

name: fabbit Kyobashi
card: 2nd floor of Central Building, right by exit 24 of the Yaesu underground mall
title: fabbit Kyobashi — private offices with a coworking lounge on the 2nd floor of Central Building, 4 minutes from Tokyo Station
lead: fabbit Kyobashi is on the 2nd floor of the Central Building in Kyobashi, right by exit 24 of the Yaesu underground mall at JR Tokyo Station. It is listed on the official website of the rental-office brand CROSSCOOP as one of its sites. Four minutes on foot from Tokyo Station, it has fully private rooms for 2 to 6, a coworking lounge and meeting rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Private rooms (2–6 people) / coworking lounge / meeting room
Right by exit 24 of the Yaesu underground mall, Tokyo Sta. (4 min) / 3 min from exit 7 of Kyobashi Sta.
concept: Ready to work from day one
The website describes “an environment fully equipped with what you need for business, such as a coworking lounge and meeting rooms, so you can start working as soon as you move in”.
Right by exit 24 of the Yaesu underground mall, it suits companies that travel often by shinkansen or to the airport.
steps: The entrance is on the 2nd floor of the Central Building.
The coworking lounge is a shared place to work outside your room.
There is a meeting room for discussions.
The website says the meeting room and offices have security systems.
Private rooms hold 2 to 6 people, all fully enclosed, and company registration is possible.
Each room has a different shape, so you can choose by headcount and use.

word.title: What is the Yaesu underground mall?
body: The shopping arcade that spreads underground on the Yaesu side of Tokyo Station. fabbit Kyobashi is right by its exit 24.
Even on rainy days, you can walk most of the way from Tokyo Station underground.

name: CROSSCOOP Roppongi NEXT
card: About 1,620 m² over two floors of Round Cross Roppongi, with a 60-seat lounge
title: CROSSCOOP Roppongi NEXT — two floors of about 1,620 m² and a 60-seat coworking lounge, on the 4th and 5th floors of Round Cross Roppongi
lead: CROSSCOOP Roppongi NEXT is on the 4th and 5th floors of Round Cross Roppongi, a two-minute walk from exit 7 of Roppongi Station. Two floors total about 490 tsubo (about 1,620 m²). It has a coworking lounge of about 60 seats with high counters, a refresh lounge, four meeting rooms, phone booths and windowed private rooms for 1 up to 40 people. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Coworking lounge (about 60 seats) / refresh lounge / 4 meeting rooms / phone booths / private rooms (1–25 people, up to a 40-person unit)
concept: Two floors, about 1,620 m²
CROSSCOOP Roppongi NEXT uses two floors of Round Cross Roppongi, the 4th and 5th, about 490 tsubo in all.
The website highlights the location two minutes from Roppongi Station, a design for small teams and companies of 1 to 20, rich shared facilities, and security for meeting rooms, lounges and offices.
steps: Staff are at reception 9:00–18:00 on weekdays.
It is a two-minute walk from exit 7 of Roppongi Station.
The coworking lounge has about 60 seats, including high-counter seats.
There is also a refresh lounge, so places to work and rest are kept separate.
Four meeting rooms and booths for calls
There are four meeting rooms: one for 4, two for 6 and one for 8.
Phone booths are available for online meetings.
Private rooms range from 1 to 25 people, with a unit for up to 40. All are fully enclosed, with windows, desks and chairs.

word.title: What is a high counter?
body: Counter seating at standing height, used standing up or on tall stools. The coworking lounge at CROSSCOOP Roppongi NEXT has it.
With a higher eye line, it suits short tasks and quick chats.

name: fabbit Aoyama-itchome
card: Private rooms for 2 to about 20, on the 8th floor of Aoyama Tower Place
title: fabbit Aoyama-itchome — private offices with a coworking lounge on the 8th floor of Aoyama Tower Place, 2 minutes from Aoyama-itchome Station
lead: fabbit Aoyama-itchome is on the 8th floor of Aoyama Tower Place, a two-minute walk from exit 4 North of Aoyama-itchome Station. It is listed on the official website of the rental-office brand CROSSCOOP as one of its sites. It has fully private rooms for 2 to about 20 people, a coworking lounge, meeting rooms and phone booths. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Private rooms (2 to about 20 people) / coworking lounge / meeting room / phone booths
2 min from exit 4 North of Aoyama-itchome Sta.
concept: On the 8th floor of an Aoyama tower
fabbit Aoyama-itchome is on the 8th floor of Aoyama Tower Place. The website calls it “a high-grade office designed for ease of work”.
Rooms range from 2 to about 20 people, fitting anything from a small team to a whole department. The shared facilities aim to balance working and refreshing.
steps: The coworking lounge is a shared workspace for private-room tenants.
There are many kinds of seating to suit the day's tasks.
There is a meeting room and phone booths.
Use them for client meetings and online calls.
Private rooms hold 2 to about 20 people, all fully enclosed, and company registration is possible.
They are rooms inside a tower two minutes from Aoyama-itchome Station.

word.title: What is a fully private room?
body: A room enclosed by walls and a door, closed all the way to the ceiling. Every room at fabbit Aoyama-itchome is fully private.
Other tenants cannot hear your conversations or see your screens.

name: CROSSCOOP Nihonbashi
card: A 43-seat lounge on the 2nd and 3rd floors of Nihonbashi 3-chome Square
title: CROSSCOOP Nihonbashi — a 43-seat lounge and nine phone booths on the 2nd and 3rd floors of Nihonbashi 3-chome Square
lead: CROSSCOOP Nihonbashi is on the 2nd and 3rd floors of Nihonbashi 3-chome Square, two minutes from Nihombashi Station and seven from Tokyo Station. The website calls it “a newly built, high-grade rental office”. It has a lounge of about 43 seats, a coworking space, a refresh lounge, four meeting rooms, nine phone booths and private rooms for 10, 20 and more. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Lounge (about 43 seats) / coworking space / refresh lounge / 4 meeting rooms / 9 phone booths / private rooms
2 min from Nihombashi Sta. / 7 min from Tokyo Sta. / 9 min from Kyobashi and Mitsukoshimae stations
concept: A newly built, high-grade office
The website introduces CROSSCOOP Nihonbashi as “a newly built, high-grade rental office with company registration, fully private rooms, Wi-Fi, a lounge and meeting rooms”.
It uses the 2nd and 3rd floors of Nihonbashi 3-chome Square, and the shared facilities are open 24 hours. Nihombashi, Tokyo, Kyobashi and Mitsukoshimae stations are all within walking distance.
steps: Four meeting rooms and nine booths
There are four meeting rooms and nine phone booths.
Client meetings and online calls can all be handled on the floor.
Private rooms include an 11-person room of 24.3 m² and a 20-person room.
All are fully private, and company registration is possible.

word.title: What is a refresh lounge?
body: A shared space for taking breaks between work. CROSSCOOP Nihonbashi has one, separate from the lounge and coworking area.
Keeping seats for work and seats for rest apart makes it easier to switch your mind.

name: CROSSCOOP Aoyama
card: Two minutes from Gaiemmae Station, with a shared-office floor on the 4th
title: CROSSCOOP Aoyama — private rooms and a shared-office floor on the 2nd, 4th and 5th floors of Landwork Aoyama Building, 2 minutes from Gaiemmae
lead: CROSSCOOP Aoyama is in the Landwork Aoyama Building (formerly Hulic Gaiemmae Building), a two-minute walk from exit 3 of Gaiemmae Station on the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line. The 2nd floor has private rooms and meeting rooms, the 4th private rooms and a shared office, and the 5th private rooms. It can be used from one person, and there are five meeting rooms for 4 to 10. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 2F private rooms, meeting rooms / 4F private rooms, shared office / 5F private rooms
2 min from exit 3 of Gaiemmae Sta.
concept: Each floor with its own role

CROSSCOOP Aoyama uses three floors of the Landwork Aoyama Building, each with its own role: the 2nd for private rooms and meeting rooms, the 4th for private rooms and a shared office, and the 5th for private rooms.
The website says it “can be used from one person, with fully private rooms for 3 to 20”. Reception is staffed 9:00–18:00 on weekdays.
steps: Beyond the entrance is reception, staffed 9:00–18:00 on weekdays.
There is a waiting area for visitors.
There are five meeting rooms: two for 4, two for 6 and one for 10.
Meeting-room fees come with a free allowance of 3 to 5 hours a day.
Rooms range from single-person rooms to fully private rooms for 3 to 20.
Utilities and air-conditioning are included in the monthly rent, and company registration is possible.

word.title: What is a shared office?
body: An office where one floor is shared by several companies or individuals. At CROSSCOOP Aoyama, the 4th floor combines private rooms and a shared office.
People who don't need a whole room can still work in the same building.

name: CROSSCOOP Shibuya
card: A 30-seat coworking lounge halfway up Miyamasuzaka
title: CROSSCOOP Shibuya — a 30-seat coworking lounge halfway up Miyamasuzaka, on floors 5–7 of the Hulic Shibuya 1-chome Building
lead: Halfway up Miyamasuzaka, the slope that runs from Shibuya Station's East Exit to Aoyama-dori, CROSSCOOP Shibuya occupies the 5th to 7th floors of the Hulic Shibuya 1-chome Building. The website describes a place where “the energy of the city centre coexists with a calm presence”. It has a 30-seat coworking lounge, a refresh lounge, six meeting rooms, five web booths and private rooms for 3 to 25. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Coworking lounge (30 seats) / refresh lounge / 6 meeting rooms (4–10 people) / 5 web booths / private rooms (3–25 people)
5 min from Shibuya Sta. / 7 min from Omotesando Sta.
concept: Energy and calm, halfway up Miyamasuzaka

CROSSCOOP Shibuya is halfway up Miyamasuzaka, the slope from Shibuya Station's East Exit to Aoyama-dori. The website describes it as a place where “the energy of the city centre coexists with a calm presence”.
Within walking distance of both Shibuya and Omotesando stations, it uses three floors, the 5th to the 7th.
steps: Six meeting rooms and five booths
There are six meeting rooms for 4 to 10 people and five web booths.
Use them for client meetings and online calls.
There are spacious window-side rooms too, so you can choose by team size.

word.title: What is Miyamasuzaka?
body: The slope climbing from Shibuya Station's East Exit up to Aoyama-dori. CROSSCOOP Shibuya is halfway up it.
A little away from the bustle in front of the station, it is where things start to feel calmer.

name: THE HUB Nihonbashi Kabutocho
card: A bold renovation of a SOHO building: every room fully private, plus a rooftop terrace
title: THE HUB Nihonbashi Kabutocho — a rental office where every room is fully private, with a rooftop terrace, in the Kabutocho Heiwa Dia Building
lead: THE HUB Nihonbashi Kabutocho is in the Kabutocho Heiwa Dia Building in Nihonbashi Kabutocho, a one-minute walk from exit 11 of Kayabacho Station. A SOHO building boldly renovated so that every room is fully private, it offers offices with a high degree of independence, plus three meeting rooms for four, a lounge and a rooftop terrace. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Fully private offices (2–10 people) / 3 meeting rooms (4 people) / lounge / rooftop terrace
concept: A bold renovation of a SOHO building
The website's headline reads: “A bold renovation of a SOHO building — offices with high independence, every room fully private.” The 10-storey building was renovated in July 2022.
Every room is fully private, from 2 to 10 people. A building of small live-work units has been reborn as a cluster of independent offices.
steps: Every room is fully private, for 2 to 10 people, with furniture, internet, lighting and air-conditioning in place, from ¥75,350 a month.
The website names independence as a key feature.

word.title: What is SOHO?
body: Short for Small Office / Home Office: a small office or a workplace that doubles as a home. THE HUB Nihonbashi Kabutocho is a renovated SOHO building, the website says.
SOHO buildings, with many small units, have the right bones for private rental offices.
